description: Synapse helps developers connect local applications to AI assistants already installed on the machine, including Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode. It manages separate application and account profiles, native sign-in and resumable runs while the application controls its prompts and workflows.

image.alt: Synapse's cobalt-blue connection mark beside converging ivory and glass paths.

artwork.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset: Synapse project card, NEW VISUAL IDENTITY. The prior machine / metal junction / terminal-box concept has been rejected entirely. Do NOT use the old Synapse artwork.
Reference image: the supplied Mosaik card establishes only the shared series composition, 16:9 framing, white seamless studio background, soft tactile ceramic/glass materials, calm lighting, black wordmark typography and left-brand/right-motif hierarchy. Match the family, not the mosaic subject.
Primary request: Create an elegant, memorable new visual identity for Synapse, the library that connects an application with multiple installed AI assistants and their sessions. Target 1280x720.
LEFT THIRD: large exact black word "Synapse". Above it, a distinctive minimalist COBALT-BLUE connection mark: three soft, rounded paths converge into one continuous clean junction, like a carefully drawn abstract branching path. Flat, confident, geometrically simple. It must NOT resemble a brain, sound waves, infinity loop, padlock, letter from another existing brand, arrows or a mechanical component.
RIGHT TWO THIRDS: an airy sculptural composition of three broad, smooth flowing ivory ceramic ribbons, with one restrained cobalt-blue ribbon/edge joining them into a precise shared meeting point. A few slim clear glass layers give a sense of independent application/session contexts, connected without becoming one indistinguishable mass. Graceful negative space, refined curves, gentle grounded shadows and natural studio depth. The sculpture should visually echo the new abstract mark and express connection and continuity.
Palette: white, warm ivory, charcoal wordmark, one confident cobalt-blue accent. No orange/mint legacy palette, neon, black metal or dark background.
Only text: "Synapse". No tagline or other prose. No devices, terminals, tiny command glyphs, pipes, wires, glowing chamber, cylinders, gears, technical machinery, robot, brain, cartoon, UI screenshot or dashboard. This is original brand artwork. Make it exceptionally art-directed and readable at small blog-card size.
